test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who is the writer of the book ‘India Divided’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajendra Prasad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajendra Prasad **was the writer of** India Divided**. The book was written to oppose the division of the country.
 
• Rajendra Prasad was the first president of India, serving from 1950 to 1962. He was a lawyer, scholar, and politician.
 
• He became a **significant leader in the Bihar and Maharashtra regions** of the Indian National Congress during the Indian Independence Movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Mulk Raj Anand **was an English-language Indian author who is most known for portraying the lives of the lower castes in traditional Indian society.
 
• During British India, **Chaudhry Khaliquzzaman** was a Pakistani politician and a prominent Muslim personality.
 
• **In 1956, Khushwant Singh** was inspired by his experiences during India's 1947 partition to create **Train to Pakistan**, which became his best-known novel.
